title: HR Reporting Analyst
description:
Job Description: Workday HR Reporting Analyst

**Experience:**
12+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location: PAN India**

**Working Hours:**
12:30 PM – 8:30 PM IST

Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Workday HR Reporting Analyst with strong expertise in Workday reporting, HR modules, and workforce analytics. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining complex Workday reports while ensuring data accuracy, security, and compliance with organizational standards.

The role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into effective reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and optimize Workday reports, including Advanced, Matrix, Composite, and Advanced Matrix reports.
* Develop calculated fields and customized reporting solutions to address complex HR and business requirements.
* Work with Workday modules, including Core HR, Position Management (PS), Workforce Administration, Recruitment, Security, Talent and Performance, Benefits, and Compensation.
* Maintain and enhance existing reports, troubleshoot reporting issues, and provide timely resolutions.
* Gather reporting requirements from HR leaders and business stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Develop dashboards and workforce analytics to support data-driven decision-making.
* Establish reporting best practices, SOPs, workflows, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with data privacy and security standards.
* Review Workday release updates, assess their impact on existing reports, and implement necessary enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams and contribute to knowledge sharing and capability building.

Mandatory Skills and Qualifications:

* 12+ years of overall professional experience.
* Minimum 10 years of hands-on Workday experience.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant Workday reporting experience.
* Strong expertise in Workday Report Writer.
* Hands-on experience developing Advanced, Matrix, Composite, and Advanced Matrix reports.
* Strong knowledge of calculated fields and custom reporting solutions.
* Experience with Workday Core HR and Position Management (PS).
* Expertise in Workforce Administration and Workday Recruitment.
* Knowledge of Workday Security, Talent and Performance, Benefits, and Compensation.
* Strong stakeholder management and requirements-gathering skills.
* Understanding of reporting governance, data quality, confidentiality, and compliance.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Competencies:

* Experience supporting global HR reporting requirements.
* Ability to interpret complex business needs and translate them into effective reporting solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Experience documenting SOPs, workflows, reporting standards, and best practices.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and reporting optimization.

Additional Information:

* Candidates should be comfortable working during the 12:30 PM – 8:30 PM IST shift.
* The role is open to candidates across India.
* Contract and full-time engagement options may be considered, depending on the hiring requirement.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Scope

Lead and manage end-to-end HR operations and the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to exit, ensuring efficient HR processes, compliance, employee engagement, accurate documentation, and a positive employee experience.

Roles and Responsibilities

* **Employee Lifecycle Management:**
  Oversee onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, employee data changes, and exit formalities.
* **HR Operations:**
  Manage HR policies, employee records, documentation, HR letters, and day-to-day HR operations.
* **Onboarding & Background Verification:**
  Ensure smooth joining formalities, background checks, induction, and completion of required documentation.
* **Payroll & Benefits Coordination:**
  Coordinate attendance, leave, payroll inputs, employee benefits, and full-and-final settlements with relevant teams.
* **Employee Relations:**
  Address employee concerns, resolve workplace issues, guide managers on HR policies, and maintain positive employee relations.
* **Performance & Employee Development:**
  Coordinate performance reviews, probation assessments, confirmation processes, and employee development initiatives.
* **Exit Management:**
  Oversee resignation processing, exit interviews, clearance, final settlements, and relieving documentation.
* **HR Compliance:**
  Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, company policies, and audit standards.
* **HRMS & Reporting:**
  Maintain accurate employee data, oversee HRMS processes, prepare HR reports, and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.
* **Team & Stakeholder Management:**
  Lead the HR operations team and collaborate with business leaders, managers, finance, and IT to ensure effective HR service delivery.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Relevant experience managing HR operations and the complete employee lifecycle, preferably in an IT organization.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies, employee documentation, payroll coordination, and labour compliance.
* Experience with HRMS platforms, HR reporting, and process improvement.
* Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information and manage multiple priorities effectively.

title: Learning and Development Manager, RFA
description:
**Job Description:**
**About AML RightSource**
We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
  
  
Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
  
  
We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
  
  
**About The Position**
We are seeking an experienced Learning and Development Manager to lead the strategy, operations, and continuous improvement of the Ready for Allocation (RFA) function in India.
  
  
The RFA group includes employees awaiting assignment to a client-focused team, typically after completing new-hire training or while transitioning between client engagements. It may also include employees on the bench awaiting project allocation in accordance with company policies.
  
  
The L&D Manager, RFA will be accountable for ensuring that employees within RFA remain skilled, engaged, professional, compliant, and ready for timely deployment. The role will oversee workforce-readiness planning, learning-needs identification, upskilling interventions, operational governance, stakeholder coordination, and the overall RFA employee experience.
  
  
This position will manage the L&D Coordinator responsible for day-to-day RFA operations and will work closely with Talent Development, Resourcing, HR, Workforce Management, Operations, and business stakeholders. The manager will use workforce data and business requirements to strengthen deployment readiness, reduce skill gaps, improve operational efficiency, and build a scalable RFA operating model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**RFA Strategy and Governance**

* Define and drive the overall RFA workforce-readiness strategy in alignment with business, resourcing, and talent priorities.
* Establish clear operating standards, governance mechanisms, escalation paths, and accountability measures for the RFA population.
* Translate organizational policies into clear and practical RFA processes, guidelines, and employee expectations.
* Monitor the health and effectiveness of the RFA model and recommend changes based on workforce data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
* Ensure consistency in the management of employees completing training, transitioning between client teams, or awaiting project allocation.

**Workforce Readiness and Deployment Enablement**

* Oversee the readiness assessment of employees within RFA and ensure that skills, development needs, availability, and deployment status are accurately tracked.
* Partner with Resourcing, HR, Operations, and business leaders to understand upcoming talent requirements and prepare RFA employees for suitable opportunities.
* Identify barriers affecting employee deployment and coordinate appropriate learning, operational, or stakeholder interventions.
* Introduce structured readiness for employees to prepare for client project allocation.
* Provide leadership with timely visibility into workforce readiness, skill availability, development priorities, and deployment risks.

**Learning Needs and Upskilling**

* Lead training-needs analysis for the RFA population using readiness data, business requirements, performance indicators, and stakeholder inputs.
* Design and oversee targeted upskilling pathways that keep employees client-ready while they await allocation.
* Prioritize learning interventions based on business demand, skill gaps, deployment opportunities, and employee readiness.
* Guide the creation of just-in-time learning resources to address immediate RFA concerns and emerging capability requirements.
* Evaluate the relevance and effectiveness of learning interventions and use findings to improve future programs.
* Collaborate with Talent Development colleagues and subject-matter experts to source, create, or facilitate appropriate learning solutions.

**Data, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Develop and maintain meaningful RFA dashboards, reports, and management insights.
* Analyze RFA data to identify skill gaps, readiness trends, allocation barriers, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Define and monitor relevant measures for readiness, learning participation, skill development, deployment enablement, compliance, and employee engagement.
* Convert operational data into clear recommendations and decision support for senior stakeholders.
* Ensure data quality and consistency across RFA trackers, reporting tools, and HR systems.
* Use insights to prioritize interventions and demonstrate the business impact of the RFA function.

**Team Leadership and Capability Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop the L&D Coordinator supporting RFA operations and enablement.
* Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development goals for the coordinator.
* Review the quality and timeliness of readiness tracking, stakeholder communication, learning interventions, and RFA engagement activities.
* Delegate operational responsibilities while maintaining accountability for overall RFA outcomes.
* Build the coordinator’s capability in data analysis, stakeholder management, learning-needs analysis, facilitation, process improvement, and project execution.
* Create a collaborative, accountable, and improvement-oriented team environment.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary Talent Development point of contact for RFA readiness and capability development.
* Build strong relationships with HR, Resourcing, Workforce Management, Operations, client-facing teams, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews to discuss RFA status, deployment priorities, emerging skill requirements, risks, and required actions.
* Clarify ownership across teams and ensure timely follow-through on agreed actions.
* Escalate critical readiness, conduct, compliance, or deployment concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Communicate RFA priorities, expectations, risks, and progress clearly to employees and leadership.

**Employee Experience, Professionalism, And Compliance**

* Create a structured and constructive experience for employees while they await allocation.
* Ensure employees understand the expectations associated with RFA, including availability, participation, learning completion, professional conduct, and communication.
* Oversee engagement initiatives that promote accountability, continuous learning, and connection to the organization.
* Work with HR and relevant stakeholders to manage recurring concerns related to participation, professionalism, conduct, or compliance.
* Ensure that RFA sessions and communications reinforce applicable company policies and workplace expectations.

**Process Improvement and Automation**

* Review existing RFA processes to identify inefficiencies, duplication, manual work, and control gaps.
* Lead improvement initiatives that simplify workflows, strengthen accountability, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of information.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring tracking, reporting, reminders, communications, and administrative activities.
* Partner with relevant technology and operations teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standard operating procedures and appropriate documentation for critical RFA processes.
* Encourage the responsible use of technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve scalability and employee support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant experience in Learning and Development, workforce readiness, talent operations, workforce management, or a related function.
* Experience leading people, projects, programs, or a significant operational workstream.
* Strong understanding of training-needs analysis, learning-program design, facilitation, and capability development.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret workforce data, identify patterns, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort working with HR systems and reporting tools.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to work across Talent Development, HR, Resourcing, Operations, and business teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project-management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes and introduce scalable ways of working.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing a bench, redeployment, talent-pool, transition, or workforce-readiness program.
* Experience leading a coordinator, specialist, trainer, or similar role.
* Experience developing dashboards and reporting for workforce or learning initiatives.
* Exposure to capacity planning, resource allocation, employee transitions, or client-readiness processes.
* Experience with workflow automation, reporting automation, or AI-enabled learning and operational solutions.
* Experience working in a global or cross-regional organization.

AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

The candidate will independently handle employee onboarding, attendance and leave management in Keka, employee documentation, background verification, HR letters, exit formalities and employee training coordination.

The role also requires developing structured HR and training processes, maintaining accurate trackers and submitting monthly reports to management.

This position does not involve recruitment or candidate sourcing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Employee Onboarding & Background Verification

- Manage complete onboarding for new employees and interns.

- Collect, verify and maintain educational certificates, identity documents and previous employment records.

- Upload and organize employee records in Keka HRMS.

- Coordinate educational certificate and employment background verification through approved verification processes.

- Track missing documents, verification status and discrepancies.

- Maintain accurate onboarding checklists.

2. Keka HRMS – Attendance & Leave Management

- Manage daily employee attendance, late coming and missing punches in Keka.

- Track attendance regularization requests and follow up with employees.

- Monitor leave applications, balances and pending approvals.

- Coordinate with reporting managers for timely leave decisions.

- Maintain accurate employee profiles and HRMS records.

- Generate monthly attendance, leave and late-coming reports.

- Share verified attendance inputs with the Finance/Payroll team.

Mandatory Keka Proficiency:

- Minimum 1 year of hands-on working experience with Keka HRMS.

- Employee onboarding and profile management.

- Attendance monitoring and regularization.

- Leave applications and approval workflows.

- Employee document management.

- Report generation and data exports.

3. HR Documentation & Exit Management

- Prepare joining, appointment and confirmation letters using approved templates.

- Prepare internship joining, completion and experience letters.

- Prepare relieving and experience letters.

- Coordinate resignations, notice periods, exit clearances and asset handovers.

- Support Finance with final settlement documentation.

- Maintain accurate and confidential employee files.

4. Employee Training & Process Development

- Coordinate new employee induction and internal training.

- Help establish structured training programs, SOPs and tracking systems from the ground up.

- Maintain training calendars, employee-wise assignments and completion trackers.

- Coordinate with department heads and trainers for training content and schedules.

- Track assessments, feedback and pending training.

- Follow up on overdue training and identify completion gaps.

- Prepare monthly training progress and compliance reports.

5. HR Issues & Monthly Reporting

- Handle routine employee HR queries professionally.

- Maintain a tracker of employee HR issues and their resolution status.

- Follow up with relevant departments on pending matters.

- Escalate sensitive issues appropriately.

- Prepare a consolidated monthly HR MIS covering:

- Attendance, late coming and regularization.

- Leave applications and approval status.

- Joining and background verification.

- Employee letters and exit formalities.

- Employee HR issues and resolutions.

- Training completion, assessments and pending activities.

- Share monthly reports and process improvement recommendations with management.

Candidate Requirements

Mandatory

- 2–4 years of overall HR operations experience.

- At least 1 year of practical experience using Keka HRMS in a professional HR role.

- Ability to independently manage Keka attendance, leave and employee records.

- Experience with employee onboarding, documentation and exit procedures.

- Good Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Polite, organized, detail-oriented and capable of independent follow-up.

Preferred

- Experience coordinating employee background verification.

- Experience maintaining employee training trackers.

- Ability to develop HR checklists, SOPs and reporting systems.

- MBA in HR or equivalent qualification.

Compensation

Annual CTC: ₹3.6–4.8 LPA

Final compensation will depend on overall experience, hands-on Keka proficiency, documentation and reporting skills, and ability to manage HR operations independently.

Important: Applicants without at least 1 year of practical Keka HRMS experience will not be considered. Recruitment is not part of this role.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
This is a full-time role based entirely at WTF's Sector 9, Noida office, six days a week. It is not remote or hybrid. Apply only if those working terms are practical for you.

We need one hands-on owner of the people function across WTF's businesses—not a coordinator and not another layer above someone else doing the work.

You will personally run the operating rhythm for hiring, employee records and payroll inputs, employee relations, performance and capability building. You will build a small team around clear responsibilities, reliable data and completed work. When a process breaks, you must be able to diagnose it, do the work and get it running again.

Show us what you have actually owned. We want a hiring funnel through actual joiners, a payroll or employee-operations problem you took through closure, and a performance or learning intervention with an observed result. Explain the starting point, dates, your actions and actual outcome. Separate your personal delivery from the company's growth or your team's totals.

This is not a TA-only, payroll-only, HRMS-only or policy-only appointment. Those specialists have their own delivery roles; this seat must connect the complete function to business outcomes. Payroll preparation must retain an independent Finance check, payment approval and release.

The assessment includes a practical HR operating case and a discussion of one redacted or recreated tracker or SOP you authored. Do not share confidential employer information or private employee data. A senior title and screening answers are not substitutes for evidence.

Please be ready to discuss your current or last-drawn CTC, fixed and variable components, notice period, current locality and realistic daily commute. Compensation is discussed after evidence review; no package or interview slot is promised by this post.

WTF is building across gyms, academy, business services, digital products and other ventures. This is a business-wide people mandate, not a gym-only HR role.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description**
UK International London Beauty School is Asia’s leading beauty education institution, headquartered in Noida, and known for setting global benchmarks in professional beauty training. The academy offers globally certified, industry-focused programs across Makeup Artistry, Cosmetology, Beauty & Wellness, Hair Styling, Skin Aesthetics, CIDESCO, and B.Voc Degree Programs in Beauty & Wellness from London. With a strong emphasis on hands-on learning, real-world exposure, and international standards, the school prepares learners for careers in salons, fashion, media, wellness, and entrepreneurship. Recognized for innovation, excellence, and robust placement support, UK International operates across Delhi NCR and multiple locations in India, enabling students to build sustainable, global careers in the beauty industry.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Human Resources Manager role based in Noida. The Human Resources Manager will oversee end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, and employee life-cycle management for academic and non-academic staff. The role involves developing and implementing HR policies, managing performance appraisal processes, and supporting leadership in workforce planning and organizational development. The Human Resources Manager will handle employee relations, engagement initiatives, grievance resolution, and compliance with labor laws and institutional guidelines. Additional responsibilities include coordinating training and development programs, maintaining accurate HR records and HRIS data, and collaborating with management to foster a positive, inclusive, and performance-driven work culture.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in talent acquisition, interviewing, and onboarding to effectively manage staffing needs.
* Experience in HR operations, including payroll coordination, attendance and leave management, and HR documentation.
* Ability to design and implement HR policies, performance management systems, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Knowledge of labor laws, statutory compliance, and best practices in workplace ethics and employee relations.
* Excellent communication, conflict resolution, and interpersonal skills to work with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Proficiency with HRIS, MS Office, and basic data analysis for HR reporting and decision-making.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar senior HR role, preferably in education, training, or service-oriented organizations.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, manage multiple priorities, and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

* Ensure timely availability of manpower according to production requirements.
* Maintain a database of potential candidates for urgent manpower requirements.
* Reduce recruitment turnaround time and workforce attrition.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, documentation, induction, and joining formalities.

**2. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Management**

* Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, late arrivals, overtime, and shift schedules.
* Ensure accurate attendance records through biometric systems and HRMS.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, deductions, incentives, and leave.
* Maintain employee records and ensure timely resolution of salary-related queries.
* Track absenteeism and implement corrective measures to improve workforce availability.
* Coordinate with production supervisors to ensure adequate manpower across shifts.

**3. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for factory employees.
* Handle employee grievances, workplace conflicts, disciplinary issues, and worker concerns.
* Maintain a positive and productive relationship between workers, supervisors, and management.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies and disciplinary procedures.
* Conduct regular employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Address issues related to employee misconduct, absenteeism, and workplace behaviour through fair and documented processes.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate records relating to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, minimum wages, overtime, and other statutory obligations.
* Coordinate with compliance consultants and government authorities whenever required.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and records required for inspections and audits.
* Ensure labour contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements.
* Support implementation of applicable occupational health, safety, and welfare requirements.

**5. Factory Discipline & HR Administration**

* Ensure adherence to factory rules, reporting timings, shift schedules, and workplace policies.
* Conduct regular shop-floor visits to understand workforce concerns and monitor discipline.
* Coordinate with production managers and supervisors on manpower utilization and productivity.
* Monitor employee movement, unauthorized absenteeism, and workplace conduct.
* Maintain employee personal files, appointment letters, warning letters, and other HR documentation.
* Support smooth employee exits, handovers, and Full & Final Settlements.

**6. Contractor & Manpower Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with manpower contractors and staffing agencies.
* Monitor contractual manpower deployment, attendance, and performance.
* Verify contractor bills against approved attendance and agreed commercial terms.
* Ensure availability of backup manpower during peak production periods.
* Monitor contractor compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies.

**7. Performance Management & HR Reporting**

* Coordinate performance reviews for factory employees and supervisors.
* Identify recurring attendance, productivity, and behavioural concerns.
* Maintain HR dashboards covering manpower strength, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, overtime, and recruitment.
* Share daily and weekly manpower reports with management.
* Support initiatives to improve employee retention, discipline, and workforce productivity.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in HR or a related qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 4–7 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant.
* Strong experience handling blue-collar and contractual workforces.
* Practical understanding of factory HR operations and labour law compliance.
* Experience in printing, packaging, fabrication, engineering, or similar manufacturing industries will be preferred.

**Essential Skills**

* Strong blue-collar recruitment capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and labour compliance.
* Experience managing factory attendance, overtime, and payroll coordination.
* Strong interpersonal skills and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Ability to handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters independently.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and attendance management systems.
* Good communication skills in Hindi and working knowledge of English.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Plant HR will be evaluated on:

1. **Manpower Availability:**
   Ensuring adequate workforce availability as per production requirements.
2. **Recruitment TAT:**
   Timely closure of blue-collar and factory-level vacancies.
3. **Attendance & Absenteeism:**
   Improvement in workforce attendance and reduction in unplanned absenteeism.
4. **Employee Retention:**
   Reduction in avoidable blue-collar attrition.
5. **Payroll Accuracy:**
   Accurate and timely submission of payroll inputs.
6. **Statutory Compliance:**
   Timely compliance with applicable labour laws and documentation requirements.
7. **Factory Discipline:**
   Effective management of employee grievances and disciplinary matters.
8. **HR Reporting:**
   Timely and accurate submission of manpower and HR reports.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is
**not limited to desk-based HR operations**
.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable spending significant time on the factory floor, interacting directly with workers, resolving workforce issues, and coordinating closely with production teams.

The candidate must be resourceful, firm yet approachable, and capable of maintaining workforce discipline while ensuring fair treatment of employees.

**Most importantly, the person should take complete ownership of plant-level HR operations rather than depending on constant supervision.**

description:
Job Description – HR & Admin Executive (Operations)

**Position:**
HR & Admin Executive

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

Noida

Full-Time

**Department:**
Human Resources & Administration

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented
**HR & Admin Executive**
with 3–5 years of relevant experience in managing end-to-end HR operations and office administration.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in employee lifecycle management, HRMS administration, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, employee engagement, vendor management and day-to-day administrative operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
* Coordinate joining formalities, induction sessions, background verification (BGV) and employee documentation.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters and relieving letters.
* Maintain accurate employee records and personnel files.
* Coordinate employee exit formalities, clearance processes and Full & Final (F&F) settlements.
* Address employee queries related to HR policies, benefits and workplace processes.

**2. HRMS, Attendance & Payroll Coordination**

* Maintain and update employee information in HRMS platforms.
* Manage attendance, leave records, employee data and related documentation.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, salary revisions and attendance reconciliation with the Finance team.
* Prepare periodic HR MIS reports, employee trackers and dashboards.
* Ensure accuracy, confidentiality and timely maintenance of employee information.

**3. Statutory Compliance & Employee Benefits**

* Maintain working knowledge of applicable Indian labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Gratuity and other relevant compliances.
* Coordinate employee benefits administration, including group mediclaim enrolment, additions, deletions and renewals.
* Assist with HR audits and statutory documentation.
* Liaise with external vendors for insurance, background verification and other employee-related services.

**4. Office Administration & Facility Management**

* Oversee day-to-day office administration and ensure smooth workplace operations.
* Manage office supplies, stationery, housekeeping, maintenance and other facility-related requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors for office infrastructure, repairs, maintenance and administrative services.
* Maintain records of company assets, employee ID cards and access cards.
* Coordinate with IT teams for employee asset allocation, system access and asset recovery during onboarding and offboarding.
* Ensure office facilities are maintained in accordance with organisational standards.

**5. Vendor Management & Administrative Coordination**

* Manage relationships with external vendors and service providers.
* Coordinate vendor quotations, purchase requests, invoices and payment follow-ups.
* Monitor service delivery and ensure timely resolution of administrative issues.
* Maintain administrative records, agreements and relevant documentation.
* Support office logistics, travel arrangements and other operational requirements as needed.

**6. Employee Engagement & Internal Coordination**

* Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities, celebrations and internal events.
* Facilitate communication between employees and management regarding HR and administrative matters.
* Support employee welfare initiatives and organisational activities.
* Assist in implementing HR policies and improving workplace processes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management or a related discipline.
* **3–5 years of relevant experience in HR Operations and Office Administration.**
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle management and general HR processes.
* Hands-on experience in office administration, facility coordination and vendor management.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience with HRMS platforms such as Zoho People, Darwinbox, Keka or similar systems.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Excel and HR MIS reporting.
* Good understanding of payroll coordination, employee benefits and HR documentation.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to independently manage multiple responsibilities.

Preferred Skills

* Experience handling both HR and administrative operations independently.
* Exposure to IT asset coordination and employee access management.
* Experience managing insurance, BGV and facility management vendors.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with HR, Finance, IT and external service providers.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Ideal Candidate

A self-driven HR & Admin professional with strong operational expertise who can independently manage day-to-day HR activities and office administration while ensuring operational efficiency, statutory compliance and a positive employee experience.

The role also includes handling routine HR queries, assisting with payroll and attendance data, and contributing to HR reporting and compliance tasks.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management for effective planning and execution of HR initiatives.
* Candidates should possess practical experience in HR Operations and HR Policies to manage processes and ensure compliance with organizational guidelines.
* Candidates should possess solid Employee Relations capabilities to support a positive workplace culture and address employee concerns professionally.
* Candidates should possess effective communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills to collaborate with stakeholders and manage multiple tasks.
* Relevant academic background, such as a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, is preferred.
* Prior experience in an HR Executive or similar HR role, ideally within a consulting or service-oriented environment, will be an advantage.
* Comfort with HRIS tools and MS Office applications, along with attention to detail and confidentiality in handling employee information, is beneficial.

title: Senior HR Business Partner (HRBP)
description:
Senior HR Business Partner (HRBP)

Talent Acquisition | Workforce Planning | Performance Management | Organizational Development

About Mirketa

Mirketa is a U.S.-headquartered technology consulting and product engineering company with an India delivery center in Noida. We specialize in Salesforce, AI/GenAI, cloud engineering, data engineering, enterprise integration and custom software development, and develop software products for healthcare, nonprofit and other sectors.

Position Overview

We seek a hands-on, results-oriented Senior HR Business Partner who will own workforce planning, recruitment delivery, performance management, employee engagement and organizational effectiveness. The HRBP will work directly with engineering and delivery leaders to anticipate talent gaps, translate business demand into hiring plans and ensure that the organization has qualified talent when needed.

The Senior HRBP will directly manage the recruitment function, including internal recruiters and external recruiting partners, and be accountable for achieving approved hiring targets across technical, program management, leadership and business roles. This includes setting individual recruiter KPIs, leading weekly pipeline reviews, addressing underperformance, and driving positions to closure within agreed quality and timeline standards. The position requires to be in Noida office 5 days / week.

Key Responsibilities

1. Workforce Planning & Talent Needs Identification

·      Partner with delivery, engineering, product and business leaders to anticipate hiring needs based on project demand, planned growth, attrition and capability gaps.

·      Maintain rolling workforce plans for technical, program/project management, leadership and business roles; identify replacement and succession requirements.

·      Recommend internal development, redeployment or external hiring based on capacity and skill availability; align requisitions with approved budgets.

2. Recruiter Management & Hiring Target Achievement

·      Directly manage internal recruiters and external recruiting agencies, including work allocation, sourcing strategy, weekly goals, coaching and performance reviews.

·      Own approved hiring plans and meet hiring targets for engineering, architecture, Salesforce, AI/data, QA, DevOps, project/program management and corporate positions at all levels.

·      Set and monitor recruiter-level KPIs for qualified submissions, screening quality, interview conversion, offers, joining rates and time-to-fill.

·      Lead weekly requisition-by-requisition pipeline reviews; resolve bottlenecks, escalate delayed decisions and address recruiter underperformance.

·      Define role profiles and screening criteria with hiring managers; ensure high-quality shortlists and structured evaluation and timely interview feedback.

·      Personally drive critical and hard-to-fill senior leadership, engineering and program management hires; coordinate specialist agencies, referrals and targeted sourcing.

·      Own offer coordination, compensation alignment, candidate engagement, pre-joining follow-through and onboarding handoff.

·      Build proactive candidate pipelines, campus and employee-referral programs and relationships within the Delhi NCR technology talent market.

3. Performance Management & Manager Accountability

·      Drive measurable goal-setting, manager 1:1s, performance reviews, calibration and individual development plans.

·      Coach managers on actionable feedback, fair evaluations and underperformance management; monitor compliance and escalate persistent gaps.

·      Establish management-effectiveness measures and support merit-based advancement and recognition.

4. Engagement, Retention & Culture

·      Analyze attrition by manager, skill, tenure and project assignment; conduct exit and stay interviews and implement corrective measures.

·      Partner with leaders to improve employee trust, teamwork, career growth, recognition and engagement.

·      Handle employee relations and grievances fairly, professionally and confidentially.

5. Learning, Succession & Talent Development

·      Maintain role-based competency frameworks, identify high-potential employees and coordinate training and certification programs.

·      Develop succession plans for critical engineering, program delivery and management positions.

·      Measure training outcomes by applied skill, readiness, promotion and performance rather than attendance alone.

6. Compensation, HR Governance & Reporting

·      Partner with Finance and leadership on compensation benchmarks, hiring budgets, offers and internal equity.

·      Maintain accurate recruitment, attrition, performance and workforce dashboards with actionable executive insights.

·      Ensure compliant HR documentation, policy implementation and professional employee relations.

Required Qualifications

·      Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years in small or mid-sized IT consulting, software services or digital engineering businesses (ideally 50–500 employees).

·      Demonstrated direct management of internal recruiters and external recruiting partners, with ownership of hiring targets and recruiter performance.

·      Strong experience with technical and program management recruiting, workforce forecasting, ATS/HRMS and hiring funnel analytics.

·      Proven execution of performance management, employee development, retention and management accountability programs.

·      Knowledge of Delhi NCR technology talent markets, compensation dynamics and hands-on consulting-company operating realities.

·      Strong stakeholder influence, data analysis, follow-through, negotiation and communication skills.

·      Ability to work daily from the Noida office during core business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

·      Salesforce, AI/GenAI, cloud and data engineering recruiting experience.

·      Proven turnaround of recruiting delivery or employee retention at a growing technology services company.

·      Established professional networks, referral channels, campus relationships and specialist recruitment partnerships.

·      Experience working with CEO/founder-led teams and building pragmatic HR governance with limited administrative overhead.

Performance Scorecard & KPIs

Recruitment performance will represent 40% of the overall role evaluation. The remaining weights below are suggested and may be calibrated against business priorities.

* **Hiring delivery & recruiter management — 40%**

At least 90% of approved roles closed within agreed, role-specific SLAs; recruiter attainment; qualified-candidate flow; conversion, time-to-fill, critical-hire closure and offer-to-join rate (target 85%+).

* **Retention & engagement — 20%**

Lower regrettable attrition against baseline; retention action-plan execution and employee feedback improvements.

* **Performance & manager effectiveness — 20%**

100% timely performance-cycle completion; 95% monthly manager 1:1 completion; quality of development plans.

* **Workforce planning & talent development — 15%**

Rolling demand forecast, skills gap coverage, succession readiness, onboarding and internal mobility.

* **HR governance & data quality — 5%**

Accurate reporting, compliant processes and timely resolution of HR matters.

Quality-of-hire indicator: target at least 90% satisfactory 90-day new-hire performance. KPI accountability assumes approved requisitions, feasible compensation bands and timely hiring-manager participation.

First 180-Day Expectations

Days 1–30 | Diagnose, Prioritize, Establish Accountability

·      Audit approved openings, existing recruiting funnels, recruiter performance, offer conversion, attrition and HR governance gaps.

·      Meet delivery/engineering leaders to validate current and forecast talent needs; build a prioritized workforce and requisition tracker.

·      Assign recruiter ownership, define weekly reporting and role-specific hiring SLAs; identify urgent technical and program management hires.

Days 31–90 | Drive Hiring Execution & People Governance

·      Run structured weekly recruiter and hiring-manager reviews; address sourcing weaknesses, delayed interview decisions and hiring risk.

·      Produce qualified shortlists and close priority requisitions; establish dedicated strategies for hard-to-fill leadership roles.

·      Implement manager 1:1, performance review and employee development tracking; begin targeted retention interventions.

Days 91–180 | Deliver Measurable Outcomes

·      Meet agreed hiring-plan targets and demonstrate improved recruiter performance, time-to-fill, conversion and joining rates.

·      Partner with the VP Engineering & Technical Delivery on critical leadership hiring, including the planned three Technical Delivery Directors and one Program Delivery Director, subject to approved requisitions and compensation.

·      Show improved performance-management completion, development-plan adoption and evidence-based retention actions.

·      Present a 12-month workforce, succession, recruitment and engagement plan supported by baseline and trend metrics.

Ideal Candidate

A highly accountable HR operator who understands project-driven consulting businesses and can personally turn hiring demand into qualified hires. This person coaches and manages recruiters, challenges hiring bottlenecks, develops managers and builds a fair, high-performing culture—not simply administers HR policies or coordinates interview calendars.

title: Organizational Workforce Transformation ( OWT) - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**U EY- GDS – People Consulting (PC), Organization and Workforce Transformation – Senior Consultant (Senior)**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant (Senior) with expertise in Organization and Workforce Transformation to join the People Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organization whilst being instrumental in the growth of the People Consulting team. Organization and Workforce Transformation comprises professionals who provide services across Organization Design, Workforce Planning, Talent Management, and Leadership and Culture. In addition to project delivery, the team supports business development, point-of-view development, proposals, and market research within the OWT portfolio.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage experience in Organization Design, Workforce Planning, Leadership and Culture, and Talent Management to deliver workforce transformation projects for global clients in collaboration with GDS teams and other EY member firms
* Provide support in capturing industry thought leadership and benchmarking organization and process metrics to create outstanding deliverables
* Follow a robust internal review process to ensure high-quality deliverables and excellent feedback from clients and global project counterparts
* Build strong relationships and drive effective communication with client and project-team counterparts across global locations
* Support the development of thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques, and methodologies to broaden capability offerings within the practice and enhance GDS awareness across the firm

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment
* Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity
* High energy levels, agility, and adaptability
* Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects approved under EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* 6–9 years of relevant experience
* Minimum two years of experience in Organization Design, Workforce Planning, and Talent Management
* Master’s degree in HR or a similar full-time MBA/EMBA
* Experience working in a consulting environment on global client projects
* Experience developing points of view and sales proposals in Organization Design and Talent Management
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to advise, challenge, and influence clients

**Good to have:**

* Experience consulting for global organizations across industries in Organization Design, Workforce Planning and Restructuring, Talent Management, and Leadership and Culture Assessment
* Experience providing Organization Design solutions and supporting decision-making on talent management and workforce planning
* Experience determining key people metrics by analysing data sets and identifying trends
* Project management experience, including tracking, benefits reporting, and stakeholder management
* Experience in organizational change management and training
* Working knowledge of HR systems and other cloud or ERP technologies

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Assistant Vice President - Manufacturing Division
description:
**Assistant Vice President - Manufacturing Division**

**About the company**

Raphe mPhibr Pvt. Ltd is India’s largest R&D-driven UAV manufacturer, revolutionizing aerospace with indigenously developed, cutting-sedge drone technology. Our UAVs have flown over 1 million kilometres across diverse terrains and weather conditions.

With 900+ talented professionals trained at premier institutions like MIT, Georgia Tech, IITs, and NITs and state-of-the-art research and manufacturing facilities, we design and build almost every component of our UAVs in-house. Our expertise spans Aerodynamics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Software, and AI, enabling us to create comprehensive and customized end-to-end solutions.

Recognized for our rapid growth and inclusive culture, we were recently named LinkedIn's Top 10 Startups 2024 and honoured with the FICCI Women's Empowerment Award. Beyond work, we foster a collaborative, fun, and inclusive workplace, supported by unique events and thoughtful policies that reflect our commitment to our people We innovate for a better society!

*We innovate for a better society!*

**Do you want?**

* The opportunity to work alongside highly innovative and technical minds?
* A competitive salary based on your skills?
* To implement strategic HR initiatives that drive organizational success?

**Job Brief:**

We are looking for an experienced
**Assistant Vice President - Manufacturing Division**
to build the talent and people ecosystem for our next-generation aerospace manufacturing operations. The role will lead strategic hiring for state-of-the-art production labs across cutting-edge technologies such as CNC, Additive Manufacturing, Laminating and composites, while partnering with Production HODs to map critical skills and build future-ready technical teams. The leader will also drive robust workforce planning, shift & roster systems, HR Operations, capability building, and Health & Safety, creating a high-performance, technology-enabled workforce that will shape the future of aerospace manufacturing.

This is a senior leadership role combining data-driven strategy, framework design and team execution.

Don’t just dream about what’s next – build it!

**Essential Skills:**

* Good understanding of manufacturing and shop-floor ecosystem.
* Ability to assess skill gaps based on machines, processes and production requirements.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**Location:**
Noida (On-site)

**Company:**
Zynence Labs Pvt. Ltd.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Industry:**
AI / Deep Tech / SaaS / Technology

About Zynence

Zynence is building an AI-native, full-lifecycle hardware engineering platform designed to transform how physical products are conceptualized, designed, developed, validated, and manufactured. Our platform brings together requirements engineering, system architecture, BOM and cost optimization, electronics and PCB design, firmware development, AI-native 3D CAD, simulation, validation, and manufacturing readiness within a connected, intelligent engineering environment.

We are an early-stage deep-tech startup with ambitious plans to build a globally scalable engineering technology company. As our team grows, we are looking for an HR Generalist who can take ownership of our people operations, build scalable HR processes, and help us attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and execution-oriented
**HR Generalist**
to independently manage day-to-day HR functions while helping establish the people infrastructure of a growing technology startup.

This is a hands-on role involving recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, HR operations, policy implementation, performance management coordination, and statutory compliance support.

You will work directly with the founders and functional teams, taking ownership of HR activities from workforce planning and talent acquisition to employee lifecycle management and organizational development.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating in an early-stage environment, can build processes from scratch, and understands that effective HR is about enabling people and business growth—not simply managing documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for technical, product, business, and operational roles.
* Collaborate with founders and hiring managers to understand hiring requirements, define job descriptions, and establish candidate evaluation criteria.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, referrals, campus networks, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen applications, conduct initial HR interviews, and coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Maintain structured candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, and applicant databases.
* Coordinate salary discussions, offer negotiations, reference checks, and joining formalities.
* Develop and maintain talent pipelines for upcoming hiring requirements.
* Build relationships with colleges, universities, and training institutions for internships, fellowships, and campus recruitment.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, interview conversion, and offer acceptance rates.

2. Employee Onboarding & Lifecycle Management

* Own the complete employee onboarding process, from offer acceptance through joining and initial integration.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, and onboarding documentation.
* Coordinate employee verification, system access, induction schedules, and departmental introductions.
* Conduct structured onboarding sessions covering company policies, processes, and expectations.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
* Manage employee confirmations, transfers, role changes, and other lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate employee exits, clearance procedures, exit interviews, and full-and-final settlement documentation.

3. HR Operations & Administration

* Establish and maintain standardized HR processes, documentation, trackers, and operating procedures.
* Manage employee attendance, leave records, holidays, and related HR administration.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, and compensation changes.
* Maintain employee databases and HR management systems.
* Ensure timely issuance and maintenance of employment-related documents.
* Support workforce planning, headcount tracking, and HR reporting.
* Coordinate with finance, administration, and external consultants on HR-related matters.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR activities and improve operational efficiency.

4. HR Policies & Statutory Compliance

* Support the development, implementation, and periodic review of company HR policies.
* Coordinate applicable statutory compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity, and other employment-related obligations.
* Maintain employment records and documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.
* Coordinate with external payroll, legal, and compliance consultants where necessary.
* Support the implementation of workplace conduct, grievance redressal, and POSH-related policies and procedures.
* Ensure employee information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection requirements.
* Stay informed about relevant changes in employment regulations and HR practices.

5. Performance Management & Employee Development

* Coordinate employee goal-setting, performance reviews, probation evaluations, and appraisal cycles.
* Work with founders and functional leads to establish role-specific KPIs and performance expectations.
* Maintain performance review schedules, documentation, and follow-up actions.
* Support the identification of employee training and development requirements.
* Assist in implementing structured feedback, recognition, and employee development initiatives.
* Help build a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and high performance.

6. Employee Engagement & Workplace Culture

* Act as an approachable point of contact for employee queries, concerns, and HR-related matters.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, internal communications, and team-building activities.
* Conduct periodic employee check-ins and help identify opportunities to improve employee experience.
* Assist in resolving workplace concerns professionally and confidentially.
* Work closely with the founders to establish a collaborative, transparent, and performance-oriented startup culture.
* Support employee retention initiatives and improvements to the overall workplace experience.

7. HR Process Development & Automation

* Build practical, scalable HR workflows suited to a fast-growing technology startup.
* Introduce structured recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, and performance tracking systems.
* Use AI tools and automation to improve sourcing, administrative workflows, documentation, and HR reporting.
* Develop standardized templates, checklists, dashboards, and internal HR knowledge resources.
* Continuously improve HR processes based on operational requirements and team feedback.

QualificationsRequired

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related discipline.
* **2–5 years of relevant HR experience**
  , preferably in a startup, technology company, or fast-growing organization.
* Hands-on experience managing recruitment and core HR operations.
* Working knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, HR documentation, payroll coordination, and applicable employment compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and common workplace productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring requirements and HR responsibilities independently.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.

Preferred

* Experience recruiting technical talent, including software developers, AI/ML engineers, electronics engineers, embedded systems engineers, or product professionals.
* Prior experience establishing or improving HR processes in an early-stage startup.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, HRMS platforms, and recruitment tools.
* Experience coordinating performance management and employee engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with AI-powered productivity and HR automation tools.
* Exposure to campus recruitment, internship programs, or university partnerships.

What We Look For

**Ownership:**
You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through without constant supervision.

**Execution:**
You can translate requirements into action and manage multiple priorities efficiently.

**People Orientation:**
You genuinely enjoy working with people and building positive employee experiences.

**Discretion:**
You understand the importance of confidentiality, professionalism, and fairness in HR decisions.

**Adaptability:**
You are comfortable working in an evolving startup environment where processes and priorities change.

**Process Thinking:**
You look for ways to make HR operations more organized, efficient, and scalable.

**Technology Mindset:**
You are open to using AI, automation, and modern tools to improve how HR functions operate.

Why Join Zynence?

* **Build HR from the ground up:**
  Play a meaningful role in establishing the people operations of an emerging deep-tech company.
* **Work directly with founders:**
  Gain exposure to organizational planning, hiring decisions, and startup growth strategy.
* **Real ownership:**
  Independently manage important HR functions rather than operating within a narrowly defined administrative role.
* **Deep-tech exposure:**
  Work alongside teams developing AI-native engineering technologies and next-generation product development solutions.
* **Career growth:**
  Opportunity to grow into broader People Operations or HR leadership responsibilities as the organization scales.
* **Startup environment:**
  Be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team where initiative and execution are valued.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or send their updated resume to:

**Email:**
sushil@zynence.com

Application for HR Generalist – Zynence

Please mention your current location, total HR experience, current and expected compensation, and notice period in your application.

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Overview**
The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.
  
  
This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast-evolving compliance landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting & Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:

+ Gratuity Act
+ Shops & Establishments Act (state-specific)
+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
+ Leave-related statutory provisions
+ Severance and separation-related compliance

* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops & Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations & HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications And Requirements**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4-7+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state-specific regulations including Shops & Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* Judgement and Integrity: Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* Collaboration & Communication: Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* Adaptability: Operates effectively in dynamic, fast-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* Operational Excellence: Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).
