title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**SENIOR HR MANAGER – MANUFACTURING OPERATIONS**

**Tributum Power Private Limited**

*An Accel1 Inc. Joint Venture | AtmosPOLE™ Manufacturing & Assembly*

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Onsite)

**Department:**
Human Resources & Administration

**Experience:**
Minimum 15 Years

**Qualification:**
MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management or Industrial Relations

**Reporting To:**
JV CEO / Senior Management

**Employment:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Industry:**
Climate Engineering | Intelligent Infrastructure | Advanced Manufacturing

**ABOUT TRIBUTUM POWER**

**Tributum Power Private Limited is a joint venture of Accel1 Inc.**
, established to manufacture, assemble, deploy and scale AtmosPOLE™, Accel1's flagship intelligent environmental infrastructure platform.

AtmosPOLE™ integrates environmental monitoring, air treatment, smart lighting, IoT connectivity, digital communication, public safety and AI-powered environmental intelligence into multifunctional urban infrastructure.

Tributum Power is establishing advanced manufacturing and assembly capabilities to support large-scale deployment of intelligent climate infrastructure.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on
**Senior HR Manager with 15+ years of experience**
to establish and lead the Human Resources and Administration function for our manufacturing operations in Noida.

The selected candidate will build HR operations from the ground up, recruit approximately
**48 manufacturing and operational professionals**
, establish HR policies, implement digital systems, manage statutory compliance and develop a high-performance organizational culture.

The role requires strong expertise in manufacturing recruitment, industrial relations, workforce planning, payroll, performance management and employee development.

**We seek an HR leader who can build an organization, not simply manage an existing department.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. HR Strategy & Organization Building**

* Establish the HR and Administration function, organizational structure, policies and procedures.
* Develop scalable HR systems aligned with manufacturing growth.
* Define employee grades, compensation structures and reporting hierarchies.
* Advise senior management on workforce strategy and organizational development.
* Build a culture of accountability, safety, productivity and operational excellence.

**2. Workforce Planning & Recruitment**

* Lead recruitment and onboarding for approximately 48 manufacturing and operational positions.
* Recruit engineers, production managers, mechanical/electrical technicians, electronics and IoT specialists, QA/QC personnel, supervisors and administrative staff.
* Develop manpower plans, recruitment budgets and hiring schedules.
* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, technical assessments and offers.
* Build partnerships with ITIs, polytechnics, engineering colleges and recruitment agencies.
* Develop talent pipelines across Noida, Greater Noida and Delhi NCR.
* Monitor recruitment timelines, costs, offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Plan future staffing requirements for manufacturing expansion.

**3. HR Policies & Employee Administration**

* Develop employee handbooks, HR policies, appointment letters and employment agreements.
* Establish attendance, leave, shift, overtime, holiday and disciplinary policies.
* Implement onboarding, probation, confirmation, appraisal and exit processes.
* Maintain employee records, statutory documentation and administrative controls.
* Ensure consistent HR policy implementation across departments.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Industrial Relations**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and Uttar Pradesh labor laws and employment regulations.
* Manage applicable EPF, ESI, gratuity, minimum wages, overtime and statutory benefits.
* Maintain factory-related employment records, statutory registers and compliance documentation.
* Oversee applicable contract labor, apprenticeship and outsourced workforce requirements.
* Establish grievance, disciplinary, employee welfare and workplace harassment prevention procedures.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, labor consultants, auditors and government authorities.
* Resolve employee disputes and maintain compliance calendars.

**5. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Develop salary structures, compensation policies and employee benefits.
* Coordinate payroll, attendance reconciliation, overtime, statutory deductions and settlements.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and timely processing with Finance.
* Develop increments, incentives and employee recognition programs.
* Prepare manpower budgets and compensation reports.

**6. Performance Management & Development**

* Establish performance appraisal systems and role-specific KRAs/KPIs.
* Implement probation reviews, evaluations and performance improvement plans.
* Develop performance-linked incentives and recognition programs.
* Support promotions, career progression and leadership development.
* Partner with department heads to improve productivity and accountability.

**7. Training & Technical Skills**

* Establish induction, orientation and employee development programs.
* Coordinate training in mechanical assembly, electrical systems, electronics, IoT and quality control.
* Develop competency matrices with Production, Engineering, QA/QC and EHS teams.
* Coordinate safety awareness and workplace training.
* Maintain training records and develop institutional skill-development partnerships.

**8. Employee Relations & Retention**

* Build a professional, inclusive and performance-oriented workplace.
* Establish grievance-resolution and employee communication processes.
* Develop engagement, welfare, recognition and retention programs.
* Conduct employee feedback sessions and exit interviews.
* Monitor attrition, absenteeism and workplace satisfaction.

**9. Manufacturing HR & Shop-Floor Operations**

* Work closely with Production Managers, Supervisors and Engineering leadership.
* Establish shift-wise manpower planning and workforce allocation.
* Monitor attendance, overtime and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate technical staffing based on production requirements.
* Support production ramp-up, workforce readiness and operational expansion.
* Reinforce workplace discipline, safety and quality expectations.

**10. HRMS, Digital Systems & Analytics**

* Implement HRMS and biometric attendance systems.
* Digitize recruitment, onboarding, employee records, payroll and performance management.
* Develop dashboards for headcount, recruitment, attrition, payroll, training and compliance.
* Ensure employee data confidentiality and reporting accuracy.
* Present HR analytics and management reports.

**11. Administration, Budgeting & Leadership**

* Oversee assigned factory and office administration and employee facilities.
* Coordinate workplace welfare and safety induction with EHS personnel.
* Prepare HR budgets, manpower forecasts and training plans.
* Report recruitment progress, compliance and workforce costs.
* Build and mentor the HR team as operations expand.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations or related discipline.
* **Minimum 15 years of HR experience**
  , preferably in manufacturing or industrial operations.
* Proven experience establishing or scaling HR functions.
* Strong technical recruitment and industrial workforce planning capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labor laws, industrial relations, payroll and compliance.
* Experience implementing HR policies, HRMS an

**FIRST 90 DAYS – EXPECTED DELIVERABLES**

**Days 1–30: Establish**

* Finalize manpower plans and recruitment priorities.
* Establish essential HR policies, documentation and onboarding processes.
* Begin hiring critical manufacturing and technical personnel.
* Assess statutory compliance, payroll and HRMS requirements.

**Days 31–60: Mobilize**

* Accelerate recruitment against agreed staffing milestones.
* Implement employee records, attendance and payroll coordination.
* Establish induction, safety awareness and training programs.
* Introduce HR dashboards, compliance tracking and departmental KPIs.

**Days 61–90: Operationalize**

* Progress toward completion of the initial recruitment plan.
* Stabilize HR administration, payroll and employee relations.
* Implement employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Conduct an initial compliance assessment.
* Present a scalable HR roadmap for future expansion.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Success will be measured through recruitment completion, time to hire, workforce readiness, employee retention, statutory compliance, payroll accuracy, training completion, KRA/KPI implementation, HRMS adoption, employee engagement and manpower budget adherence.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates are requested to send their updated résumé to
**careers@accel1.com**
with the subject line:

**Application – Senior HR Manager – Tributum Power**

Please include your current designation, total HR and manufacturing experience, current and expected CTC, notice period, and current location.

**Apply Now:**
**careers@accel1.com**

title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

**Tower:**
Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:**
People manager

**Scope:**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.

We are currently seeking a P&O / OCM Senior Manager to join our team in Delhi, India.

NTT DATA’s People & Organizational Consulting Practice delivers on the promise to help our clients’ people and organizations meet the evolving demands of business and the workforce. In this India-based role, you will help lead and scale our P&O offshore delivery team while partnering closely with North America leaders and client-facing teams to deliver high-quality consulting solutions.
  
  
Why the Role Is Important:
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking a dynamic People & Organization / OCM Consulting Senior Manager to help lead our India-based P&O offshore delivery team and support a successful People & Organization Consulting Practice. As a Senior Leader in this practice, your typical day will include client delivery, go to market support, and internal practice contributions across India and North America:
  
  
Client contributions:
  
  

* Serve as an expert senior advisor and delivery leader for global clients embarking on change initiatives, with accountability for offshore delivery quality and outcomes.
* Develop, lead, and execute comprehensive and customized People & Organization and OCM strategies in partnership with North America client teams to maximize employee adoption and minimize resistance.

* Manage change readiness, adoption baselines, measurement, and monitoring to assess the effectiveness of People & Organization activities and ensure consistent reporting across offshore and North America teams.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to client executives and sponsors by facilitating leadership alignment and developing change strategies that enable successful enterprise transformation.
* Apply best practice OCM methodologies to develop a customized client change management approach.
* Identify new and innovative ways to accelerate clients through their change journey.

Internal practice contributions:
  
  

* Coach, manage, and mentor India-based P&O offshore delivery talent at various levels to high performance and high-quality results.
* Support North America practice and account leaders with solution design, client proposals, budget forecasting and management, engagement planning, offshore delivery estimates, and resourcing.
* Build strong internal networks and partnerships across India and North America to support business expansion opportunities, delivery continuity, and career growth.
* Engage in the hiring process for offshore delivery roles, including evaluating potential candidates, interviewing, and supporting onboarding into the P&O practice.
* Assist with the development of thought leadership, collateral, delivery assets, tools, and templates that can be leveraged consistently across offshore and North America teams.

  
  
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* You have a bachelor’s degree in business, HR, organizational development, I/O psychology, communications, or equivalent combination of related education, training, and experience.
* You have 5 years of recent consulting experience, including experience growing a practice, partnering with sales and account teams, developing advisory-level client relationships, and supporting business development through pricing estimates, presentations, and delivery planning.
* You have 5 years of experience leading successful medium to complex organizational change management engagements with distributed, offshore, or cross-regional delivery teams.
* You have 2 or more years’ experience building, leading, coaching, and managing a matrixed and cross-functional team of up to 20 members
* You have have a preferred certification.
* You have the ability to work effectively across India and North America time zones and travel as needed for client, practice, or team priorities.
* You have experience using AI tools to improve consulting delivery, including research, analysis, content development, productivity, and responsible innovation in client and internal work.

  
  
Preferred Skills:
  
  

* You have 5 or more years in organization development / design; organizational effectiveness; culture and workforce transformation; learning and training design, development, and delivery; Configured Platforms (i.e. SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow) implementations.
* You have impressive communication skills and the ability to craft executive summaries, detailed reports, status updates, and delivery communications across India and North America.
* You are a collaborative team player who leads by example, works effectively across cultures and time zones, and brings a dependable, flexible, results-driven commitment to success.

The ideal mindset of a Management Consultant in this role involves a blend of strategic thinking, delivery discipline, adaptability, cross-cultural collaboration, and strong interpersonal skills. title: Lead Assistant Manager – India HR Statutory Compliance
description:
Basic Function

The Lead Assistant Manager – India HR Statutory Compliance will be responsible for executing day-to-day India HR statutory compliance operations under the supervision of the HR Statutory Compliance leadership. The role will support statutory compliance activities across applicable Indian entities and locations, including social security operations, payroll-linked statutory compliance, statutory filings and records, employee benefit case execution, vendor and contract labour compliance support, audit documentation, government notice and inspection coordination, Labour Code transition support, regulatory tracking, and digital compliance initiatives. The role will also manage employee-level statutory benefit queries for active and inactive employees, ensure timely case execution on EPF/ESIC and related platforms, maintain accurate documentation, coordinate with stakeholders, and escalate complex, VIP, grievance, or authority-sensitive matters to the Functional Head / Senior Manager for review and resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Statutory Compliance Operations Support**

1. Support operational compliance activities under applicable central and state labour laws, including EPF, EPS, EDLI, ESIC, Gratuity, LWF, Professional Tax, Shops and Establishments, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Maternity Benefit, Employment Exchange, and other location-specific labour requirements.
2. Ensure monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and annual statutory activities, filings, registers, challans, returns, acknowledgements, and supporting records are completed within prescribed timelines.
3. Track assigned compliance calendar items, pending cases, ageing, evidence closure, and escalation points for periodic leadership review.

2.
**Labour Code Readiness and Transition Support**

1. Support implementation readiness for the four Labour Codes, including the Code on Wages, Code on Social Security, Industrial Relations Code, and Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code.
2. Assist in mapping legacy statutory obligations to Labour Code requirements, including wage definition, appointment letter governance, social security coverage, working conditions, registers, returns, records, and digital compliance requirements.

3.
**Employee Benefits Query Management and Statutory Case Execution**

1. Execute employee-level statutory benefits queries raised through online service desk platforms, Alumni Portal, emails, and other approved channels for active as well as inactive employees.
2. Perform first-level query triage, classification, routing, follow-up, and closure tracking, and escalate complex cases, VIP queries, grievances, and authority-sensitive matters for review and resolution.
3. Execute EPF transfer, withdrawal, pension, EDLI settlement, ESIC enrolment, UAN activation, e-Nomination, Aadhaar seeding, DBT enablement, and related statutory benefit transactions on applicable digital platforms.
4. Administer death claim cases, including nominee verification, legal heir validation, documentation follow-up, settlement coordination, and escalation to the Functional Head / Senior Manager wherever authority liaison or legal review is required.
5. Execute complex statutory benefit cases such as blocked UANs, duplicate UANs, legacy records, overlapping employment, pension eligibility issues, and portal exceptions, while flagging matters to the Functional Head / Senior Manager for authority liaison wherever required.
6. Coordinate with Payroll, HRSS, and Finance for employee benefit matters, payroll-linked statutory corrections, contribution validation, employee master data issues, and supporting documentation.
7. Support employee outreach activities relating to UAN activation, e-Nomination, Aadhaar seeding, DBT enablement, and other statutory benefit enablement drives.

4.
**Contract Labour and Vendor Compliance Support**

1. Support contract labour and manpower vendor compliance activities, including deployment validation, monthly vendor audits, statutory document review, and compliance evidence tracking.
2. Coordinate issuance of Form V, contractor licence validation, principal employer records, and vendor compliance dashboards in line with applicable CLRA and Labour Code transition requirements.
3. Follow up with compliance partners and business stakeholders for timely closure of gaps, escalations, remediation actions, and audit observations.

5.
**Statutory Notices, Inspections and Authority Support**

1. Prepare, maintain, and track statutory notices, inspection notices, conciliation matters, EPFO/ESIC/Labour Department communications, and authority submissions.
2. Coordinate data, records, replies, representations, and acknowledgements with internal teams and compliance partners for timely submission to statutory authorities, wherever assigned.
3. Support attendance and representation before labour, EPFO, ESIC, and other statutory authorities along with the Functional Head, Senior Manager, or authorized representative, wherever required.

6.
**Audit Documentation and Statutory Case File Maintenance**

1. Maintain audit-ready statutory case files, employee benefit records, registers, returns, challans, acknowledgements, inspection records, correspondence, and supporting evidence.
2. Support internal audits, external audits, compliance partner reviews, management reviews, and employee benefit/statutory case documentation requirements as per defined guidance.
3. Track audit observations, corrective actions, responsibility owners, timelines, and closure evidence until final resolution.

7.
**Digital Compliance, Regulatory Intelligence and Process Improvement**

1. Monitor statutory notifications, minimum wage revisions, state-specific amendments, government circulars, portal changes, and compliance alerts relevant to Indian labour and employment laws.
2. Support automation and digital enablement initiatives relating to compliance calendars, regulatory intelligence, case trackers, employee queries, documentation repositories, and management dashboards.
3. Identify recurring compliance issues, process gaps, portal dependencies, and stakeholder delays, and recommend practical improvements for stronger governance and SLA adherence.

8.
**Stakeholder Coordination, MIS and Operational Support**

1. Coordinate with Payroll, HRSS, HRMS/HR Technology, Finance, Employee Relations, Business HR, Compensation and Benefits, compliance partners, and relevant internal stakeholders for assigned statutory compliance and employee benefit deliverables.
2. Support daily operations, statutory compliance deliverables, query handling, documentation quality, tracker hygiene, SLA adherence, and escalation protocols.
3. Prepare structured MIS, case trackers, compliance calendars, issue trackers, benefit query dashboards, audit updates, and escalation notes for leadership review.

**Primary Internal Interactions -**
Payroll, Finance, HR Shared Services, HRMS/HR Technology, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Relations, Business HR, Procurement, Administration, Corporate Audit, HR Compliance, and leadership stakeholders.

**Primary External Interactions -**
Compliance partners, payroll/statutory vendors, EPFO, ESIC, Labour Department, Professional Tax/LWF authorities, Shops and Establishment authorities, contract labour authorities, and other government/statutory authorities, as applicable.

**Requirements**

**Technical / Functional Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour and employment laws, including EPF, EPS, EDLI, ESIC, Gratuity, LWF, Professional Tax, Minimum Wages, Shops and Establishments, CLRA, Bonus, Maternity Benefit, and related state-specific requirements.
* Good understanding of the four Labour Codes and their impact on wage definition, social security, working conditions, digital records, registers, returns, contract labour, and employer compliance governance.
* Hands-on working knowledge of Payroll processes, EPF/ESIC tools, EPFO and ESIC portals, UAN management, employee query systems, service desk platforms, and statutory documentation repositories.
* Advanced working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, dashboards, trackers, data analysis, and MIS reporting.

**Process and Governance Skills**

* Ability to execute India HR statutory compliance operations, high-volume employee statutory benefit queries, EPF/ESIC cases, payroll-linked statutory corrections, escalations, case documentation, audit responses, vendor compliance follow-ups, and authority-sensitive matters as per defined process and guidance.
* Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, compliance calendar discipline, SLA tracking, and risk-based issue escalation.
* Ability to translate statutory requirements into practical process steps, checklists, trackers, dashboards, and stakeholder action items.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to draft clear, professional, and audit-defensible communications.
* Stakeholder management, follow-up discipline, ownership mindset, urgency, logical problem-solving, and ability to work under time-bound statutory deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate cross-functionally, maintain confidentiality, handle employee-sensitive statutory matters, and escalate complex matters appropriately.

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* LLB – Bachelor of Laws / Bachelor of Legislative Law in India, with specialization, coursework, or strong exposure in Labour and Employment Laws, will be preferred or Graduate degree in any discipline; Postgraduate qualification, diploma, or certification in Labour Laws, HR, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management, or Compliance will be an added advantage.
* Relevant experience in India HR statutory compliance, social security operations, employee benefit case execution, EPF/ESIC/UAN case handling, payroll-linked statutory support, labour law compliance, or payroll/statutory operations.
* Prior experience in multi-location compliance operations, authority coordination, audits, compliance partner management, and Labour Code transition projects will be an added advantage.

(THIS IS AN IMMEDIATE JOINING)

**About Amitoje India**

Amitoje India Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing company specializing in innovative retail display solutions, branding, printing, and fabrication. We operate in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where workforce efficiency, operational discipline, and timely execution are critical.

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on
**Plant HR professional**
who can independently manage HR operations at our Noida manufacturing facility, with a strong focus on blue-collar workforce management, recruitment, statutory compliance, and employee relations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Blue-Collar Recruitment & Workforce Planning**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment of factory workers, machine operators, helpers, technicians, supervisors, and other production personnel.
* Develop reliable recruitment channels through contractors, local references, manpower agencies, and direct hiring.
* Ensure timely availability of manpower according to production requirements.
* Maintain a database of potential candidates for urgent manpower requirements.
* Reduce recruitment turnaround time and workforce attrition.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, documentation, induction, and joining formalities.

**2. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Management**

* Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, late arrivals, overtime, and shift schedules.
* Ensure accurate attendance records through biometric systems and HRMS.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, deductions, incentives, and leave.
* Maintain employee records and ensure timely resolution of salary-related queries.
* Track absenteeism and implement corrective measures to improve workforce availability.
* Coordinate with production supervisors to ensure adequate manpower across shifts.

**3. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for factory employees.
* Handle employee grievances, workplace conflicts, disciplinary issues, and worker concerns.
* Maintain a positive and productive relationship between workers, supervisors, and management.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies and disciplinary procedures.
* Conduct regular employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Address issues related to employee misconduct, absenteeism, and workplace behaviour through fair and documented processes.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate records relating to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, minimum wages, overtime, and other statutory obligations.
* Coordinate with compliance consultants and government authorities whenever required.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and records required for inspections and audits.
* Ensure labour contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements.
* Support implementation of applicable occupational health, safety, and welfare requirements.

**5. Factory Discipline & HR Administration**

* Ensure adherence to factory rules, reporting timings, shift schedules, and workplace policies.
* Conduct regular shop-floor visits to understand workforce concerns and monitor discipline.
* Coordinate with production managers and supervisors on manpower utilization and productivity.
* Monitor employee movement, unauthorized absenteeism, and workplace conduct.
* Maintain employee personal files, appointment letters, warning letters, and other HR documentation.
* Support smooth employee exits, handovers, and Full & Final Settlements.

**6. Contractor & Manpower Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with manpower contractors and staffing agencies.
* Monitor contractual manpower deployment, attendance, and performance.
* Verify contractor bills against approved attendance and agreed commercial terms.
* Ensure availability of backup manpower during peak production periods.
* Monitor contractor compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies.

**7. Performance Management & HR Reporting**

* Coordinate performance reviews for factory employees and supervisors.
* Identify recurring attendance, productivity, and behavioural concerns.
* Maintain HR dashboards covering manpower strength, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, overtime, and recruitment.
* Share daily and weekly manpower reports with management.
* Support initiatives to improve employee retention, discipline, and workforce productivity.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in HR or a related qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 4–7 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant.
* Strong experience handling blue-collar and contractual workforces.
* Practical understanding of factory HR operations and labour law compliance.
* Experience in printing, packaging, fabrication, engineering, or similar manufacturing industries will be preferred.

**Essential Skills**

* Strong blue-collar recruitment capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and labour compliance.
* Experience managing factory attendance, overtime, and payroll coordination.
* Strong interpersonal skills and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Ability to handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters independently.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and attendance management systems.
* Good communication skills in Hindi and working knowledge of English.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Plant HR will be evaluated on:

1. **Manpower Availability:**
   Ensuring adequate workforce availability as per production requirements.
2. **Recruitment TAT:**
   Timely closure of blue-collar and factory-level vacancies.
3. **Attendance & Absenteeism:**
   Improvement in workforce attendance and reduction in unplanned absenteeism.
4. **Employee Retention:**
   Reduction in avoidable blue-collar attrition.
5. **Payroll Accuracy:**
   Accurate and timely submission of payroll inputs.
6. **Statutory Compliance:**
   Timely compliance with applicable labour laws and documentation requirements.
7. **Factory Discipline:**
   Effective management of employee grievances and disciplinary matters.
8. **HR Reporting:**
   Timely and accurate submission of manpower and HR reports.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is
**not limited to desk-based HR operations**
.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable spending significant time on the factory floor, interacting directly with workers, resolving workforce issues, and coordinating closely with production teams.

The candidate must be resourceful, firm yet approachable, and capable of maintaining workforce discipline while ensuring fair treatment of employees.

**Most importantly, the person should take complete ownership of plant-level HR operations rather than depending on constant supervision.**

description:
***Company Overview:***

*Workspend is a leading global provider of contingent workforce management solutions for Fortune 500/Global 2000 clients. Workspend is one of the fastest growing companies in the industry and currently supports over 40 clients to manage their temporary workforce and total talent solutions. Workspend is an innovative company, and we are using the latest innovative technologies to disrupt the workforce industry.*

**Job Summary:**

The Program Specialist is responsible for supporting temporary/contingent workforce programs for our clients. The Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with Hiring Managers and suppliers to support and manage the full lifecycle for the requisition process including requisition intake, shortlisting, Supplier sourcing management, onboarding, worker assignment management, time and expense, offboarding and reporting. The Program Specialist acts as a talent advisor and strategic business partner to support our clients and ensure requisition fulfillment for quality talent in a timely manner. The role offers an excellent opportunity for someone to learn strong leadership skills and grow in their careers

**Responsibilities:**

* Managing hiring manager relationships and at times interacting with client’s executive leadership to ensure all contingent labor needs are fulfilled.
* Managing the staffing and requisition fulfillment process – ensuring that the client’s needs are being met. Including, but not limited to: Assisting client managers during all stages of the contract labor acquisition process including: requisition intake, sourcing, candidate shortlisting and interviewing
* Document requirement intake conversations in appropriate database (VMS etc.)
* Discuss with HM agree upon expectations, timeframes, feedback, roles and responsibilities of everyone involved in the requisition fulfilment process
* Work with and communicate with staffing suppliers to make sure that proper feedback, projections, and critical communications are being relayed in a timely manner.
* Facilitation of on-boarding and off-boarding of contractors
* Maintain the VMS (vendor management system) with strong attention to details of staffing, hiring and on boarding process of the contingent workforce. This will include updating the system with rate changes, processing contract extensions, processing releases/terminations and updating other data as necessary.
* Work to identify new opportunities to expand client relationships by partnering with the delivery teams to provide proactive solutions to current and future challenges.
* Provide strong professional management of the contingent workforce to include, but not limited to, interviewing, screening, selection/deselection, orientation, supervision, coaching, counseling, and disciplinary actions up to and including releases/terminations based on client guidelines.
* Coach, manage and oversee performance of participating staffing suppliers
* Document all client/supplier reported issues and track resolution through to completion ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction
* Conduct supplier scorecard reviews, including performance discussions, metric adherence and strategic conversations
* Accurate and on-time completion of reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Conduct new hire orientation with all prospective candidates per customer guidelines.
* Conduct regular meetings with the customer managers to ensure effective communication.
* Monitor and address issues and concerns with the contingent workforce quickly and effectively; escalate issues to management as needed.
* Assist with development of presentation and customer facing items (QBRs, Operational reviews, Dashboard reviews, other), with support from leader
* Assist with worker assignment management (cost center changes, extension of contract assignments etc.) to improve data integrity
* Liaison with managers, vendors and security department to ensure all necessary paperwork is completed and collected prior to starting assignments and at end of assignments
* Ensure all work orders are closed in the system with accurate finish reasons when notified of an end of assignment and appropriate departments are notified (i.e., security)
* Assist with the collection of company assets from vendors (laptop, badges, etc.)
* Work hand in hand with the program management team to ensure metrics, SLAs, and targets are driven with a vision and are being met.
* Serve as the professional representative of Workspend to the client – solving problems and diligently following up to ensure best in class service to the client.
* Work with the client to help identify departments, skill set categories, divisions and locations where Workspend’ s services could assist in cost savings, risk aversion and efficiencies.

description:
**About Creme Castle**

**We’re not just making desserts. We’re building a dessert culture in India. 🍰**

Born in a home kitchen in 2013, Creme Castle has grown into one of North India’s exciting dessert brands, bringing fresh, innovative and iconic desserts to customers across cities.

From product innovation and central kitchens to stores, technology and last-mile delivery, every part of our business works together to make something extraordinary happen - every single night.

Today, our desserts reach customers across
**10 cities through 45 dark stores**
, powered by a growing team of 350+ people.

We move fast, experiment boldly and keep creating what’s next.

**Decisions Driven by Data:**
We believe in facts over assumptions and encourage people to challenge ideas with evidence.

**Ownership from Day One:**
We believe great people do their best work when they have the freedom and responsibility to make a real impact.

**Growth & Opportunity:**
As we expand into new cities and build new capabilities, we create opportunities for people to learn, lead and grow with us.

**One Team, One Standard:**
Whether it’s a dessert made in Noida or delivered in another city, we work towards one consistent experience for every customer.

**Build the next Big Thing with us.**

At Creme Castle, you’ll work in a fast-moving environment, collaborate closely with leaders, take on meaningful challenges and see the impact of your work firsthand.

We’re looking for curious minds, passionate builders, problem-solvers and people who aren't afraid to challenge the ordinary.

If you love creating, moving fast and making a difference, there’s a place for you here.

**Come make the next drop.**

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Manager – HR Operations**
to independently manage end-to-end HR operations, payroll, statutory compliance and employee lifecycle processes across our corporate office, kitchens and dark stores.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Payroll Management**

* Manage monthly attendance and leave cut-offs, payroll inputs, joiners, exits, increments, deductions and salary processing.
* Prepare salary registers and payslips and reconcile payroll data with the Finance team.
* Ensure payroll accuracy, confidentiality and timely salary disbursement.

**2. Statutory Compliance**

* Manage monthly and periodic compliance relating to PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure timely filings, payments and documentation.
* Coordinate statutory audits, inspections and compliance-related queries.

**3. Registrations and Licences**

* Manage Shops & Establishments registrations, renewals and applicable registrations across the head office and dark-store locations.
* Handle contract labour compliance for employees deployed through third-party vendors, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with external consultants, vendors and relevant authorities as required.

**4. Employee Onboarding and Documentation**

* Complete joining formalities from Day 1, including employee master creation, personal files, offer and appointment letters, ID cards and HRMS/attendance setup.
* Coordinate PF, ESI and group insurance enrolments, as applicable.
* Maintain accurate, complete and audit-ready employee records.

**5. Employee Lifecycle and Exit Management**

* Issue confirmation, increment, transfer, experience and relieving letters.
* Manage resignations, exit clearances, handovers and full and final settlements within agreed timelines.
* Ensure timely closure of employee documentation and settlement records.

**6. HRMS and Attendance Management**

* Administer HRMS, biometric systems, attendance and leave management across locations.
* Ensure data accuracy, timely updates and effective coordination with store and kitchen teams.
* Resolve routine system and employee data discrepancies.

**7. Benefits and Insurance Administration**

* Manage employee enrolments, additions, deletions and updates under group medical and personal accident insurance policies.
* Coordinate with insurers and employees for policy-related queries and claim support.

**8. HR Policy Administration**

* Ensure consistent implementation of leave, attendance, reimbursement and other HR policies.
* Identify exceptions, maintain records and escalate deviations for approval.
* Support the rollout and communication of HR policies and processes.

**9. Audits and Employee Relations Support**

* Coordinate labour inspections, statutory audits and internal HR audits.
* Maintain supporting records, registers and documentation.
* Support the Talent Acquisition & Business Partnering Manager with disciplinary documentation and employee relations processes.

**10. HR Reporting and MIS**

* Prepare monthly HR operations dashboards covering headcount, payroll costs, employee movements and statutory compliance status.
* Maintain accurate HR MIS and provide data-driven insights to management.
* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to strengthen operational efficiency.

**Candidate Profile**

* 5–8 years of experience in HR Operations, preferably in a multi-location & fast high growth organizations.
* Prior experience in payroll management, statutory compliance and end-to-end employee lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Shops & Establishments requirements and contract labour compliance, as applicable.
* Experience managing HRMS, attendance systems, payroll records and HR MIS.
* Exposure to retail, QSR, food & beverage, bakery, FMCG, hospitality, cloud kitchens or other frontline-intensive businesses is good to have but not mandatory
* Strong Excel/MIS skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Ability to independently manage HR operations across the corporate office, kitchens and multiple store locations.
* Strong coordination, documentation, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.

**What We Are Looking For**

A hands-on HR professional who takes ownership, maintains high standards of accuracy and compliance, works well in a fast-paced environment and can build reliable HR processes as the business continues to expand.

**Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will be preferred.**

**Location:**
Sector 67, Noida

**Working Days:**
6 days a week

title: Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning
description:

We are looking for a highly organized and analytically strong finance professional to join our Development & Design Finance group as a Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning. This role is pivotal in bringing greater structure, consistency, and coordination to our annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning activities.
  
  
For individuals eager to improve processes, promote alignment across teams, and ease complex planning cycles, this position offers extensive interaction with Finance, People & Culture, Group Finance, RCOE, and D&D leadership.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning, you will support the core planning and forecasting operating rhythm for D&D. You will assist in structuring timelines, templates, inputs, assumptions, and follow-ups so finance partners and business leaders can plan with greater accuracy, consistency, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Support the planning and forecasting calendar across D&D, including annual plan, rolling forecast, monthly updates, and key submission achievements.
* Assemble and synchronize inputs across Finance, Studios, Product, Technology, People & Culture, Group Finance, and RCOE to support alignment and timely delivery of planning assumptions.
* Keep transparent trackers for forecast submissions, open items, risks, delayed inputs, approvals, and follow-up actions.
* Help prepare planning outputs that are consistent, comparable, and ready for D&D Finance and leadership review.
* Develop, sustain, and enhance headcount planning templates across D&D, incorporating role-level, location, cost center, hiring, attrition, and transfer inputs.
* Help establish a more structured operating rhythm for planning across D&D, reducing last-minute churn and improving transparency.
* Partner closely with People & Culture and Finance teams to align headcount assumptions, open roles, hiring timing, compensation inputs, and workforce changes.
* Create repeatable processes and controls that improve data quality, reduce rework, and make headcount planning easier to manage across cycles.
* Support clear variance explanations for headcount, compensation, and related cost movements across plan, forecast, and actuals.
* Find opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning and forecasting processes across D&D.
* Maintain planning documentation, process maps, templates, and operating guides to support consistency and knowledge transfer.
* Build trusted relationships by being responsive, organized, and clear on ownership and next steps.
* Support alignment across collaborators by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex, multi-participant planning cycles.

What We're Looking For
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in FP&A, planning, forecasting, business operations, finance transformation, project management, or related analytical roles.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount planning, and recurring finance operating rhythms.
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, collaborators, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams.
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint, paired with a focus on detail and the talent to generate clear, accurate, and logically arranged work products.

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

* Are very organized and enjoy simplifying complex planning processes to make them more predictable.
* Can balance detailed data work with project management, collaborator coordination, and executive-ready communication.
* Have strong communication skills and can make timelines, asks, risks, and decisions clear to different audiences.
* Build credibility through accuracy, responsiveness, ownership, and strong follow-through.
* Bring a continuous improvement outlook and look for ways to reduce rework, standardize inputs, and improve the planning experience for partners.

title: ER & Policies Associate Manager
description:
**Role Summary**
 The Employee Relations \& Policies – L8 role is a
 **Associate manager‑level position** 
 responsible for
 **independently managing complex employee relations matters** 
 , providing
 **policy and ER advisory to senior stakeholders** 
 , leading
 **investigations and disciplinary decisions** 
 , and
 **driving ER governance, risk mitigation, and process excellence** 
 .
   

  

 The role acts as a
 **trusted advisor to HR and business leadership** 
 , with a strong focus on
 **fairness, compliance, and risk management** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Employee Relations \& Case Management**
* Independently manage complex and sensitive ER cases, including misconduct, grievances, ethical concerns, and policy violations.
* Lead end‑to‑end investigations (fact finding, interviews, documentation, assessment, recommendations, and closure).
* Handling sensitive cases involving mental health issues, police matters, court proceedings, and similar concerns.
* Recommend and execute appropriate disciplinary actions, not limited to warnings, final actions, or terminations.
* Ensure timely, fair, and consistent resolution of cases while minimizing business, reputational, and legal risk.
* Participate in change management initiatives that require strategic involvement from ER.


**Policy Interpretation \& Advisory**
* Provide expert interpretation of HR policies, Code of Business Ethics, and internal governance standards.
* Advise HRBPs and business leaders on policy application, employee risk, and ER strategy.
* Drive policy communication, awareness, and adherence across the organization.


**Stakeholder \& Leadership Engagement**
* Interact directly with senior HR leaders and business leadership as a trusted ER advisor.
* Exercise independent judgment on ER decisions with significant day‑to‑day and long‑term impact.
* Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Ethics, and CI teams, including BEL and litigation‑sensitive matters.


**Risk Mitigation \& Governance**
* Proactively identify trends, repeat risks, and systemic issues to prevent escalations and litigations.
* Ensure timely escalation to Legal for potential or active litigation matters.
* Participate in ER governance, audits, internal controls, and compliance reviews.
* Drive process improvements, audit closures, and action plan management.


**Behavioral Assessment \& Human‑Centered Approach**
* Apply behavioral insight to assess intent, context, and conduct
* Differentiate capability, behavior, and misconduct concerns
* Lead empathetic, professional employee interactions
* De\-escalate sensitive situations effectively
* Promote fair and dignified outcomes within HR boundaries


**People \& Team Responsibilities**
* Manage and guide a medium‑sized ER team (directly or matrixed – organization decision).
* Coach and support team members, including acting as a buddy or back‑up during leadership absence.
* Ensure workload management, quality, consistency, and capability uplift within the team.


**Decision‑Making Authority**
* Acts independently on ER decisions within defined governance.
* Decisions have lasting impact on employees, teams, and organizational risk posture.
* Solutions are not limited to disciplinary actions and may include corrective, preventive, or restorative approaches.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
**Functional**
* Strong expertise in Employee Relations, Investigations, and HR Policies
* Solid understanding of employment law principles and internal compliance
* Risk assessment and mitigation
* Documentation and case articulation


**Behavioral / Psychology‑Driven**
* Strong emotional intelligence and active listening
* Ability to assess behavior, motivation, and situational context
* Calm, grounded handling of sensitive or distressing scenarios
* Balanced application of empathy and accountability


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Typically 8–12 years of HR / ER experience, with significant hands‑on ER exposure
* Experience or academic background as a counseling psychologist is preferred
* Education or experience in Psychology, Counseling, Social Work, or Behavioral Sciences (preferred)
* Prior experience managing complex investigations and senior‑stakeholder cases
* Experience working in large, matrixed organizations
* HR / Law background preferred (not mandatory)


**Level Indicators (L8\)**
* Operates with minimal supervision
* Manages complex cases and teams (organization discretion)
* Influences outcomes beyond own scope
* Recognized as a subject‑matter expert in ER \& Policies


**Role Boundaries (Important Clarity)**
* The role does not provide clinical counseling or therapy
* Psychology background is applied to better decision‑making, conversations, and outcomes, not medical or therapeutic intervention
* All actions remain within HR, policy, and governance frameworks

description:

 The

The role serves as the central point of coordination for HR compliance, policy governance, workplace accommodations, and employment\-related regulatory initiatives, ensuring adherence to applicable Central and State labour laws and organizational standards.

 Ultimately, this role enables the organization to maintain a strong culture of compliance, governance, fairness, and operational excellence while supporting business growth, protecting the organization from employment\-related risks, and enhancing the employee experience through consistent and legally compliant people practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**HR Regulatory Compliance \& Governance**
* Lead and govern the organization's HR regulatory compliance framework across all India operations, ensuring adherence to applicable Central and State labour laws.
* Establish and continuously improve governance frameworks, compliance controls, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure sustainable compliance.
* Develop and maintain annual compliance calendars, statutory obligation trackers, governance dashboards, and compliance scorecards.
* Monitor legislative developments and evaluate their impact on HR policies, processes, and business operations.
* Drive implementation of regulatory changes through cross\-functional collaboration and change management.
* Conduct periodic compliance health checks, gap assessments, and risk reviews, and oversee timely closure of corrective actions.


**People Practices \& Policy Governance**
* Own the end\-to\-end governance of HR and Employee Relations policies, guidelines, standards, and procedures.

* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of people practice across the organization.

**Employee Relations Support**

* Partner with HR Business Partners, Employee Relations Leads, Legal, Facilities, Occupational Health, and business leaders to evaluate accommodation requests and recommend appropriate workplace solutions.
* Develop and maintain accommodation frameworks, guidelines, approval processes, and documentation standards.
* Review and advise on Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), disciplinary actions, grievance handling, misconduct matters, and separation processes to ensure legal compliance and consistency.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Communication**
* Serve as the central point of coordination for HR compliance and governance initiatives across HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Security, Internal Audit, and Legal.
* Facilitate cross\-functional governance meetings, working groups, and steering committees to drive accountability and execution of compliance initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external statutory compliance vendors, consultants, and regulatory service providers.
* Coordinate statutory compliance audits, inspections, regulatory filings, and documentation with external partners.
* Develop executive dashboards and reports providing visibility into HR compliance health, regulatory risks, policy governance, audit findings, accommodation trends, and Employee Relations risks.
* Prepare and deliver presentations and compliance updates for HR Leadership, Executive Leadership, Legal, and Governance Committees.
* Partner with Global Legal, Global Compliance, Global HR, and Centres of Excellence to ensure India\-specific legal and regulatory requirements are incorporated into global people practices.
* Represent India in global governance forums, policy reviews, and compliance initiatives.

**Compliance**

* Regulatory Compliance \& Internal Controls


**Risk Management**
* Risk Assessment \& Compliance Audits
* Documentation Management \& Corrective Actions


**Communication \& Stakeholder Management**
* Stakeholder \& Executive Communication
* Negotiation, Coaching \& Presentation Skills


**Analytical Skills**
* Data Analysis \& Trend Identification
* Reporting, Problem Solving \& Decision Making


**Why Join Us**
 This role offers the opportunity to lead and strengthen the organization's Employee Relations and Compliance function by driving regulatory excellence, enhancing governance practices, and fostering a fair, ethical, and compliant workplace. The Employee Relations Compliance Lead will work closely with HR, Legal, Compliance, and business leaders to influence strategic decisions, mitigate organizational risk, and contribute to a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail\-oriented professional with strong expertise in employee relations, employment law, compliance governance, and workplace investigations, who thrives in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment and is passionate about delivering compliant and employee\-centric solutions.

title: Director, Learning & Development
description:
We are looking for a Director, Learning \& Development to join our IP team in Noida to lead the end‑to‑end strategy, design, and execution of capability‑building programs across the IP Segment. This role will own the vision, design, governance, and impact of learning across the full colleague lifecycle—from foundational onboarding to advanced applied capability through IP Academy and associated initiatives.
   

  

 The role will ensure that colleagues across Product, Content, Commercial, Technology, Operations, and Customer‑facing teams develop the IP fluency and applied skills needed to deliver on Clarivate’s IP growth strategy.
   

  

**About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments**
* 10–15\+ years’ experience in Learning \& Development, Capability Building, or Product/Commercial Enablement.
* Strong understanding of IP products, data, workflows, and customer use cases (or ability to rapidly acquire this).
* Demonstrated experience designing structured, progressive learning architectures in complex global organizations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate at executive level.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling, and program leadership skills.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams.


**It would be great if you also had . . .**
* Experience in IP, technology, SaaS, data, or professional services sectors.
* Background in product training, commercial enablement, or customer education.
* Familiarity with LMS platforms and learning analytics.


**What will you be doing in this role?**
* Learning Strategy \& Vision
* Define and maintain a unified IP Learning \& Development strategy aligned to segment growth priorities, product evolution, commercial goals, and customer experience expectations.
* Establish a clear learning architecture including:
+ Foundational onboarding
+ Role\-based essential and intermediate pathways
+ Advanced applied capability through strategic initiatives

* Lead the strategic evolution of IP Academy as the structured, role\-based learning engine of the segment.
* Ensure learning priorities reflect real business needs, product lifecycle changes, and customer workflows.
* Program Design \& Ownership
* Lead the design and continuous evolution of structured IP Learning Pathways, ensuring clear progression from foundational knowledge to advanced applied capability.
* Ensure curriculum integrates with core IP concepts, product capabilities, quality standards, commercial acumen and end\-to\-end customer workflows.
* Maintain coherence, rigor, and measurable impact across all learning tracks.
* Partner with Product, Commercial, and Operations leaders to develop sessions grounded in real\-world workflows, integration points, and applied business scenarios.
* Own the end\-to\-end new hire learning experience for IP roles, including structure, sequencing, content standards, assessment, and capability milestones.
* Establish and govern a globally consistent, scalable, and trackable onboarding framework that accelerates time\-to\-competency and ensures measurable readiness outcomes.
* Content Excellence \& Thought Leadership
* Champion simple, high\-quality learning design that minimizes SME burden while maximizing learner impact.
* Lead development of practical, reusable learning assets (e.g., visual workflows, two\-pagers, case\-based modules, demo\-driven sessions).
* Embed applied case methods and scenario\-based learning aligned to real customer usage.
* Build and govern a centralized, reusable IP learning asset library across platforms.
* Governance \& Stakeholder Partnership
* Act as the primary learning advisor to the IP Leadership Team.
* Establish a pragmatic governance model to prioritize topics and quarterly themes (e.g., Product \+ Commercial \+ Operations steering group).
* Partner cross\-functionally with Product Management, Customer Relationship Management, Sales Enablement, Operations, Technology and Content.
* Influence senior stakeholders to align capability\-building efforts with business outcomes.
* Measurement, Insights and Impact
* Implement a clear, positive, and outcome\-focused measurement framework including:
+ Reach and engagement metrics
+ Capability/fluency progression indicators
+ Application evidence within 30–60 days

* Provide quarterly impact reporting to IPLT, highlighting capability trends, skill gaps, and strategic learning priorities.
* Continuously refine programs based on measurable business impact and learner insights.
* Learning Operations \& Platform Leadership
* Oversee end\-to\-end learning operations including scheduling, delivery, tracking, certification, and quality assurance.
* Ensure seamless management of IP Academy LMS and associated tools.
* Lead vendor relationships and evaluate technology enablers to enhance scalability and learner experience.
* Build operational rigor while maintaining simplicity and accessibility.


**About The Team**
 The IP Academy team is the central capability engine for the IP Segment, responsible for designing and delivering scalable, role\-based learning that builds IP fluency and applied expertise across the organization. The team partners closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, Technology, and Customer\-facing functions to translate complex IP workflows, product capabilities, and client use cases into structured, high\-impact learning experiences.
   

  

 With a strong focus on business alignment and measurable outcomes, the team enables colleagues across the lifecycle—from onboarding to advanced capability—to develop the knowledge and skills required to deliver high\-quality execution, improve customer outcomes, and support Clarivate’s IP growth strategy. Operating within a global context, the team drives consistency, simplicity, and scalability in how learning is designed, delivered, and governed, while continuously evolving IP Academy as a strategic platform for capability building across the Segment.
   

  

**Hours of Work**
* This is a full\-time role requiring 40 working hours per week based out of Noida, India
* Work Mode\-Hybrid as per Clarivate location


 At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

 •    Design and run retention programmes targeted at the 0–90 day window, where most frontline attrition occurs.
 



 •    Build exit analytics — reason codes, tenure cohorts, site and process\-level patterns — and convert them into operational interventions, not just engagement activity.
 



 •    Partner with Operations leadership so retention actions land with team leaders, not only with HR.
 



**2\. PAN India ER Strategy \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER framework end\-to\-end for all ICCS centres (Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and any new sites), ensuring consistent grievance redressal, disciplinary process and investigation protocols.
 



 •    Own ER case TAT and SLA commitments against every open case, and personally intervene on high\-risk or aging matters.
 



 •    Build and standardise ER policies, SOPs and escalation matrices consistently across all sites and processes.
 



**3\. Grievance Handling \& Investigations** 




 •    Lead or oversee investigations into employee complaints — misconduct, harassment, policy violations — ensuring principles of natural justice are followed throughout.
 



 •    Conduct or supervise disciplinary hearings and domestic enquiries, working closely with site HR and Operations.
 



 •    Ensure fair, prompt and confidential handling of every case, with documentation that stands up to audit and legal scrutiny.
 



**4\. Statutory Compliance \& POSH** 




 •    Own POSH compliance PAN India — constitution and functioning of Internal Committees (IC) at every location, awareness sessions, and timely closure of complaints within statutory timelines.
 



 •    Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, and other state\-specific regulations across all centres.
 



 •    Liaise with legal counsel on ER matters that carry litigation or regulatory risk.
 



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Listening** 




 •    Run skip\-level connects, engagement surveys and floor\-level listening mechanisms, particularly at frontline/production level.
 



 •    Analyse exit interview and case data to identify ER\-linked attrition drivers and recommend systemic fixes to Operations and HR leadership.
 



**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Management** 




 •    Manage works/grievance committees as required under Standing Orders, and act as the primary liaison between employees, Operations leadership and HR on sensitive matters.
 



 •    Partner closely with Operations, Legal and Compliance teams on high\-risk or reputationally sensitive cases.
 



 •    Build, mentor and manage a PAN India ER team of 8–10 across locations — setting case\-quality, TAT and attrition\-outcome standards.
 



**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER and attrition dashboard and report monthly on attrition performance, case volumes, TAT, closure rates and POSH compliance status to the CEO's office and Head – HR.
 



 •    Maintain complete case documentation and ensure audit\-readiness across all centres at all times.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Employee Relations / Industrial Relations, with direct ownership of an attrition number — not case management alone.
 



 •    Has owned an attrition number across a workforce of 3,000 or more in a BPO or similar high\-churn environment, with a measurable, personally\-driven reduction backed by before\-and\-after figures.
 



 •    Mandatory: current or recent experience within the BPO / ITES / Contact Centre / Shared Services industry, with direct ER exposure in a high\-volume, frontline environment.
 



 •    Managed a PAN India, multi\-location ER team of 8 or more (minimum 3–4 locations), ideally including Noida/Delhi\-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience conducting domestic enquiries and POSH investigations, from complaint intake through to closure.
 



 •    Working knowledge of applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Contract Labour Act and related state regulations, including contract labour compliance.
 



 •    Experience partnering with Legal and Operations leadership on high\-risk or litigation\-prone cases.
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Experience in a unionised or union\-attempt environment.
 



 •    Exposure to predictive attrition analytics.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Generalist HRBPs who have supported attrition initiatives without owning the number.
 



 •    Corporate or white\-collar ER backgrounds with no frontline, high\-churn exposure.
 



 •    Candidates who describe retention purely as engagement activity — events, celebrations, rewards — with no analytical basis.
 



**Education** 




 •    Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Ownership of an attrition number as a business metric, backed by data.
 



 •    Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance.
 



 •    Excellent investigation, case\-management and documentation skills.
 



 •    Stakeholder management across Operations, Legal and employees at all levels.
 



 •    High emotional intelligence, discretion and conflict\-resolution ability.
 



 •    Team building and people leadership across a distributed, PAN India team.
 



 •    Data orientation — comfortable building and defending an attrition / case\-management dashboard/MIS.
 



 •    Ability to operate calmly and objectively in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, sensitive\-case environment.

Role:
 **HR Business Partner**
 Experience Range: 10 –12 years
   

  

 Company: NewSpace Research \& Technologies
   

  

 Industry: Engineering \& Product \|Deep Tech / R\&D / Aerospace
   

  

 Location: NCR
   

  

**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT)**
 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s leading Aerospace \& Defence innovation company developing next\-generation autonomous systems, AI\-driven aerial platforms, and advanced technologies for defence and dual\-use applications.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and manufacturing, solving complex real\-world problems with speed, precision, and purpose. Our portfolio includes intelligent uncrewed systems such as Autonomous Swarming Drones, Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicles (CCAV), Tethered Platforms, High\-Altitude Pseudo Satellites (HAPS), Loitering Munitions, and many more.
   

  

 With 500\+ engineers across R\&D and manufacturing, we collaborate with leading Indian and global Defence \& Aerospace organizations to build the future of autonomous systems.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a hands\-on, strategic HR Business Partner to work closely with leaders across engineering, product, and manufacturing functions — the teams shaping India’s next generation of aerospace and technology systems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high\-performance, high\-velocity environment, understands technology and manufacturing cultures, and can translate business goals into people strategies. You’ll partner with leaders to shape the organization’s capability, drive performance, ensure compliance, and enhance the overall employee experience — while staying deeply grounded in day\-to\-day HR execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Business Partnering
* Partner with functional heads to align people priorities with business objectives, ensuring workforce readiness and capability for upcoming projects.
* Drive organization design, manpower planning, and succession strategies aligned to growth.
* Use HR analytics and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making around talent and engagement.
* Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent performance, structure, and employee relations.
* Talent \& Capability Development
* Work closely with the TA function to ensure timely onboarding of the right talent for each function.
* Own the onboarding and assimilation experience, ensuring new hires have clear 90\-day plans and connect well with their teams.
* Identify key skill gaps and coordinate with L\&D to design upskilling, reskilling, and leadership development interventions.
* Support career progression and internal mobility frameworks.
* Performance \& Rewards
* Lead the performance management cycle – goal setting, continuous feedback, appraisal discussions, and performance improvement plans.
* Partner with the compensation team to drive salary reviews, benchmarking, and rewards programs.
* Support the implementation of variable pay, incentive, and recognition frameworks.
* Ensure internal equity and consistency in compensation and progression decisions.
* Employee Relations \& Engagement
* Foster a culture of openness, inclusion, and performance accountability.
* Lead employee engagement and communication initiatives that enhance morale and retention across sites.
* Manage grievances, employee relations cases, and workplace conflict with fairness and discretion.
* Conduct skip\-level connects, stay interviews, and feedback sessions to identify engagement drivers.
* HR Operations, Payroll \& Compliance
* Partner with HR Operations to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee records, and documentation.
* Ensure smooth handling of HRIS, attendance, and compliance activities across employment categories (permanent, contract, consultants).
* Work closely with Finance for payroll audits, budget validation, and manpower cost controls.
* Oversee policy implementation, discipline cases, and ensure adherence to all applicable labour laws and new codes.
* Administrative \& Site HR Responsibilities
* Manage on\-ground administrative HR tasks — employee data updates, vendor HR coordination, and HR\-related communication for the BU/site.
* Ensure all HR activities at the business unit or facility level run smoothly — from attendance tracking to compliance checks.
* Support logistics for employee onboarding, travel reimbursements, events, and welfare programs.


**Skills \& Attributes**
* Strong business acumen and understanding of engineering/manufacturing environments.
* Proven ability to balance strategic influence and operational execution.
* Experience driving performance, rewards, and engagement frameworks in a fast\-paced tech setup.
* High ownership, agility, and comfort in managing multiple priorities.
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with HRMS tools, payroll systems, spreadsheets, and HR analytics dashboards.
* Fluency in English; working knowledge of Kannada and/or Hindi is an advantage.


**Experience \& Qualification**
* Master’s degree in Human Resources or Business Management (Engineering background preferred).
* 10–12 years of total HR experience, with a minimum of 8 years in an HRBP role supporting technology, product, or manufacturing functions.
* Experience in deep\-tech, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing organizations is a strong plus.
